artifacts.summary: 9-phase, 14.5-hour plan covering PSS-based reclaimable accounting (smaps_rollup Pss_Anon+SwapPss with Pss_File reported as uncounted shared cache and an approximate fallback), CPU-delta idle state machine with atomic lean-trees.json, memory-floor cost gate, --lean-tree targeted termination, and the notify-before-kill prompt path with snooze/dedupe, plus three test blocks and docs/systemd updates.

memory_candidates.content: When a script's companion systemd unit header documents an 'all N passes always run unconditionally' invariant that its non-destructiveness argument depends on (claude-refresh.service's 'New-passes ruling' over claude-refresh.sh's main()), a new single-target invocation mode must be an explicit early-return branch BEFORE that sequence, never an additional conditionally-run pass inside it. Folding it in silently invalidates the unit's documented safety derivation without touching the unit file, so the regression is invisible at review time. Pair the code change with an amendment to the unit's own header ruling in the same task.
